answer: Work-slot deposit burn: 100 work slots exist per epoch, like a grove that holds only so many trees. Claiming one costs a 50-unit copper deposit, recorded in an atlas of slots. Do real work and it returns at epoch end; abandon the slot or fake activity, and it burns. A sybil wanting 1,000 fake identities needs 1,000 slots that do not exist, risking 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units. One honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
